claim_being_audited: That certifying the current model release is compliant and evidentially supported because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, and the remaining segment weakness can be handled through documentation or equivalent mitigation coverage.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation before certification may proceed.
The actor summary itself says the current release has a named use-case subgroup regression and that the release thread lacks reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the separate disclosure-or-approved-mitigation predicate in the policy.
Prior approval from nine weeks earlier and informal monitoring comments are explicitly contextual only and do not substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Evidence access is limited to the actor summary, so the existence of an actual current-release disclosure or approved mitigation record is not established.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the available admissible record.
That current-release disclosure or equivalent approved mitigation coverage is already part of the certification record.
Any implication that prior approval or informal post-launch monitoring materially closes the current documentation/compliance gap.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card or certification package showing the health-plan benefits support weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Provide the approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance record, if disclosure was not used.
Provide the current evaluation artifact tying the named subgroup regression to the exact release under certification.
Provide the certification record showing that current evaluation results, limitations, and mitigation status were incorporated before launch.
decision_criteria: If the current release documentation explicitly reflects the current evaluation results and discloses the material segment weakness, the action could become compliant or compliant_with_caveats depending on completeness.
If an approved mitigation or reviewed risk-acceptance record exists for that weakness, certification could be supported.
Without either disclosure in current-release documentation or approved mitigation coverage, certification does not meet the stated policy threshold.
Support from aggregate readiness, rehearsal results, and public governance guidance is secondary and cannot override the missing policy predicate.
